about: Within a relatively short period of time, Desmond Irvine Brazil has emerged as a stalwart advocate for his clients within his legal community, emphasizing personalized attention, meticulous focus on every aspect of their cases and an enthusiastic zeal to see them free of their legal woes. At The Law Offices of Rodger C. Daley and Associates in Denver, Colorado, he handles all matters pertaining to family law, including divorce and separation, child custody and support, enforcement and modifications, and many more. In addition, he is well-versed in diligently tackling many types of criminal law cases in an effort to protect his clients’ rights and freedoms, as well as helping individuals plan for their futures with Estate Plans, Wills, and Trusts.

After completing his undergraduate studies, Mr. Brazil attended the University of Denver Institute of Public Policy and earned his Master of Arts degree in public policy. He then enrolled in the University of Denver Sturm College of Law, and during his time there, he served at the Civil Rights Clinic and the Tribal Wills program, helping individuals who require deft legal representation. After receiving his Juris Doctor, he became licensed to practice law in Colorado in 2019.

After graduating from law school, Mr. Brazil went on to serve as a law clerk for the Second Judicial Circuit, giving him ample exposure to the inner workings of the local judiciary he would soon operate in. He later worked as a deputy district attorney for the Jefferson County District Attorney’s Office, where he gained immense practical knowledge of how to operate in local courtrooms. The knowledge he gained during this time informs his practice daily, giving his clients an added advantage in their legal matters.
